svg.title: European outreach detail
svg.desc: Cyan: France, Italy, Netherlands, Spain, Ireland, Sweden, Denmark, Portugal, Czechia, Slovakia, Belgium, Croatia, Romania, Latvia, Hungary, Iceland, Bulgaria and Greece, contacted on 26 October 2026 through 17 emails and one acknowledged form submission. Green: country and territory entries in the historical outreach list, still under review. Colors do not indicate regulatory receipt, approval or endorsement. EU-level outreach is listed separately on the page.
